summary: Composio Phase 2 fully validated. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass — admin gates, agent-tool-prefs CRUD + persistence, /composio/execute envelope-on-failure (NOT 500), llm_calls telemetry with kind_label=composio:<toolkit>:<slug>, is_agent_tools_enabled helper default-OFF/upserted-ON, AND chat regression: normal reply works with tools OFF (default), and ON+no-connections silently falls back to LlmChat. Frontend smoke: AgentToolPrefsPanel renders 171 agents (matches the ~170 catalogue), search box visible, first toggle flipped false→true via UI and the PUT round-tripped to backend. Conversation page tool-message rendering not exercised — see context note.

issues: AgentToolPrefsPanel is mounted INSIDE the 'Org setup & insights' collapsible accordion which is collapsed by default. The anchor #agent-tools therefore doesn't auto-scroll/expand the panel into view on direct deep-link. Minor UX nit — consider auto-expanding the accordion when location.hash === '#agent-tools', or moving the panel above the accordion.

critical_code_review_comments: composio_agent.run_with_tools correctly returns (None, []) when there are no tools or no connections, so the existing LlmChat path remains the source of truth for the default case. Verified by chat regression test.

/composio/execute: the route wraps execute_tool in try/except → HTTPException(500). execute_tool itself already catches SDK exceptions and returns {success: False, response: {error}, error}, so the 500 path is only hit for truly unexpected errors. Unconnected-toolkit case is correctly handled as 200 envelope (verified).

Admin gate on PUT /agent-tool-prefs/{agent_id} returns 404 for unknown agent BEFORE checking admin role — that's fine since require_org_member ran first; an org member learning the agent id space is harmless.

Telemetry: composio_agent._record_llm_call uses _CALL_CTX which only populates when called from within generate_agent_reply's context; standalone /composio/execute records via composio_integration.execute_tool's own llm_calls insert (with composio:<toolkit>:<slug> label) — verified end-to-end (count went up after the unconnected GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL call).
AgentToolPrefsPanel lives inside the collapsed 'Org setup & insights' accordion on OrgPage. The #agent-tools anchor doesn't auto-expand it. Small UX issue, not a blocker.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke — panel renders 171/~170 agents, search present, toggle flip + backend round-trip confirmed)
